title: Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī (Sharaf al-Dīn ʿAlī Yazdī's correspondence, with items on Ibn Turka and his family)
genre: letter collection (munshaʾāt); not by Ibn Turka

date.basis: Items about the Turka family range from ca. 817/1415 to after 867/1463; the MS Sinā 316 colophon gives 849/1445 for the compilation, which is after Qivām al-Dīn's death (830/1427), so the attribution and date are confused

place: Shiraz and Herat (Yazdī's office as Ibrāhīm Sulṭān's munshī)
addressee: various Timurid notables; contains seven items (eight in MS Sinā 316) about Ibn Turka or his family
occasion: Yazdī's letters, prefaces and inscriptions, often attributed to his brother Qivām al-Dīn; the Turka items include Jamāl al-Dīn's student petitions and Yazdī's condolence to Ibn Turka's children
manuscript: MS Vahid Paşa 621; MS Revan 1019; MS Majlis-i Sinā 316; Cambridge H.5; MS Dānishgāh 2576
summary: Not a work of Ibn Turka but the second source for his circle: Yazdī's letters show him at his teacher's majlises and on journeys to Herat, caring for his children after his death, and include a request for Ibn Turka's Persian works from a Tarkhān amir; edited by Afshār and Abūʾī Mahrīzī (Tehran 2009).
